latest.title: Automating Enterprise Compliance with a custom Kiro Power: Building a To-Do App Under Governance
latest.description: Build a Kiro Power that automates enterprise compliance for regulated environments. This post walks through creating an Enterprise Governance Power with three patterns: (1) Knowledge-augmented standards enforcement via Bedrock KB + MCP; (2) Bidirectional document conversion between DOCX/PDF/XLSX and markdown, with branded templates; (3) AI assurance walkthrough that ingests regulatory frameworks and derives structured assessments with confidence ratings. Demonstrated end-to-end by building a To-Do app.

latest.title: 🚀 Elevating Posture: Building an AI-Powered AWS Security Maturity Agent (Serverless & Zero-Trust)
latest.description:
Modern cloud engineering faces a costly paradox: slow, manual security audits versus expensive, legacy tools. The issue isn't missing data, but the operational fragmentation needed to prioritize it. True resilience requires moving past static snapshots.

To solve this, ASMMv2 introduces an autonomous, 100% serverless AI agent. It automatically evaluates cloud environments against the official AWS Security Maturity Model v2 framework, turning fragmented telemetry into a prioritized roadmap.
